part.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the end and is now resting about half a metre in front of the red wall. Both sonars read 0.54 m, and the camera shows the wall filling the view. It never fell.

It took five turns to get there: left, right, left, a short right-hand jog, then left at the end, where the red wall came into view.

In a few narrow spots the robot drifted toward the right-hand wall and its built-in collision protection stopped it. Each time, a small step to the left let it carry on. By the end, its position estimate didn't quite agree with what the camera showed, so I steered by the camera images instead.
